correctness.rationale: Exact Taylor-jet norm identity and unique parity-restricted monic minimizers are proved. The vanishing jet estimates and finite-dimensional invertibility force unique limiting polynomials for all fixed degrees; leading terms follow from the surviving highest jets. Log-energy bounds sqrt(2ar) ≤ cap ≤ sqrt(2r(a+r)) establish capacity normalization. A no-dependency rational-moment checker confirms n≤6, but infinite statements rest on proof.

value.rationale: Determines which fixed-order least-squares capacity bounds genuinely detect separation of two tiny components. The even indices become asymptotically optimal despite fixed degree, while adjacent odd indices lose a known square-root factor; this exposes a geometric parity discontinuity invisible to the fixed-K increasing-degree theorem and calibrates practical low-degree moment capacity estimates.
